snippet.title: Undead Chronicles | Trailer
snippet.description:
Undead Chronicles is a first-person, narrative-driven survival horror game set in Istanbul, 1923, during the final days of the Allied occupation. The game blends historical reality with a grounded zombie outbreak, focusing on tension, silence, and slow, brutal encounters.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3997960/Undead_Chronicles/
